prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserving full-equipment mecha source refinement.
Create ONE FULL-BODY source-design sample of Complete King / M05, the imposing 20m autonomous full-armored champion. This is a capable glamorous champion, not a joke buried in useless parts.
Input 1 (latest M05) is the BODY, HEAD FAMILY AND COLOR authority: navy/ivory/crimson/gold champion with layered gold head crown, solid ivory face mask, right drill, left broad shield, ornamental angular armor.
Input 2 (F04) is the actual layered WING/BACKPACK construction to restore: primary/secondary/tertiary blade wings, short vector finlets and clustered thrusters on real root hinges. Preserve that mechanical family; do not use literal feather wings.
Input 3 is earlier actual project full-equipment art. Use its powerful WEAPON MASS, wrist drill connection, shoulder-back cannon pivots and redundant equipment density. Do NOT copy its old photo/PBR style or red pectoral palette; input 1 governs current colors and body identity.

HEAD: handsome compact symmetrical helmet, TWO mirrored pairs of gold antennae, one short forward centerline forehead ram above the red forehead plate; no nose spike. Blue sensor eyes, smooth closed ivory faceplate with a clean bevel and no mouth slits/chevrons. Preserve the latest recognizable champion crown. No tall ears borrowed from Unbranded One and no hair. Head and chest remain clearly visible, not swallowed by the loadout.
BODY: navy pectoral armor with restrained gold champion ornament, ivory shoulder/thigh/shin plates, crimson waist/inner accents, gold edges and graphite joints. Strong athletic humanoid anatomy with two normal complete legs and feet. A few broad painted surfaces stay legible between weapons. Preserve the latest M05 shield's IVORY face with navy frame, gold rim and small crimson inset; not a differently colored shield on each page.

Restore abundant REAL EQUIPMENT with clear placement:
- ONE HUGE metallic-gold spiral DRILL docked to the robot's anatomical RIGHT forearm (viewer-left in this near-frontal view). Continuous shoulder -> upper arm -> elbow -> navy motor sleeve -> circular wrist coupling -> gold cone. Drill is an arm attachment, longer than forearm. No leg drills, hip drills or groin cone.
- Broad LEFT forearm shield (viewer-right), same ivory/navy/gold/crimson design as input 1. Left hand/forearm connection readable.
- EXACTLY TWO major rectangular heavy cannon housings carried by round horizontal elevation trunnions on the BACKPACK behind the two shoulder blades. Swing forward over the shoulders; both bores point PARALLEL FORWARD with the torso and remain clear of the head. These two primary cannons are not a V aimed sideways/upward and are not helmet-mounted. Show rear pivot/cradle structure and both muzzle openings. No firing effects.
- Reinstate input 2's impressive multi-tier swept angular wings and short root finlets on each side. Distinct primary/secondary/tertiary layers, visible small root hinges and deep-navy structure, ivory/gold/red blade faces. Wing roots sit behind the shoulders and outside the cannon pivot path. Clustered thrusters can show beneath the wing roots.
- Add coherent backup WEAPON PODS at wing roots and OUTER THIGHS, plus compact outer-calf auxiliary launcher cases: dark navy/ivory protective cases, a few visible recessed tube apertures, gold mounting brackets. This restores the dense whole-equipment silhouette missing from input 1. Keep normal knee hinges, ankles and boots visible and the stance credible. Nothing sprouts from between the legs.
- Separate these into mounted groups with depth/negative-space gaps rather than random tiny spikes and floating greebles. Genuine luxury and redundancy, mechanically supported.

Pose/composition: ONE robot in a confident neutral three-quarter-front display stance, both feet planted and visible, moderate wing deployment behind, right drill angled down-left with elbow visible, left shield slightly outward so torso/pelvis can be read. No impact scene or dramatic foreshortening. Entire crown, wing tips, drill tip and soles inside generous margins. Broad landscape about 4:3, not multiple views or an equipment infographic.
STYLE: polished current KINETIC_CEL painted illustration: confident varied dark contours, crisp large color planes, one/two hard cel shadows, selective mechanical seams. No photoreal PBR/toy shine, noisy crosshatching, glow fog or washed-out palette. Keep the different character colors; no teal/orange recolor.
Actual transparent background, no scenery, floor, halo, cast shadow, title, English labels, arrows, logos, watermark or extra robots.
